intro: Lesson 49: Case study: the Holderness coast, a developed country (2.3). Answer every question. Show your working. Mark it with the mark scheme and log any errors in your repair list.

questions.q: Build a case study fact file (location, geology, processes, rates, impacts) and answer: 'Explain the impacts of coastal erosion on people in a named area.'
questions.a: Accurate, specific impacts with place detail
questions.model: Teacher fills in location and geology first.

questions.q: Explain how erosion at Holderness benefits Spurn Head.
questions.a: Eroded sediment is carried south by longshore drift (1) and deposited at Spurn Head (1)

questions.q: Why might erosion rates vary along the coast?
questions.a: Defences, beach width and local geology differ

questions.q: Describe the location of the Holderness coast.
questions.a: East coast of England in East Yorkshire (1), between Flamborough Head and Spurn Head, facing the North Sea (1)
questions.model: Country and region. Between two named places. Which sea it faces.
